bullets.text: Two school students drowned in Puzhal lake near Ambattur, and the office should monitor safety measures around water bodies.
Dengue fever caused a young fatality in Thiruvallur, prompting public appeals that require health department attention.
An electrician was arrested for allegedly assaulting a woman in a Velachery women's hostel, and the office must track safety.
A tender worth 23 lakh rupees was floated to restore Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals to prevent floods, which the office should review.
A University of Madras study linked rapid urban expansion and shrinking water bodies to flood risks in Chennai.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release an integrated management plan.
Minister Vijay Balaji inspected monsoon preparedness work in the Ambattur zone of the Greater Chennai Corporation.
Firefighters rescued an 8-foot python from a factory near Avadi, highlighting wildlife safety concerns.
The collector released the revised draft polling station list for 10 assembly constituencies in Thiruvallur district.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre.
A 110-acre Fintech City business district for BFSI companies is coming up on Mount Poonamallee Road in Nandambakkam.
Buzz is growing about actor Dhanush's political entry as Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam welcomed him while stressing full-time commitment.
The Government of India opened applications for the IndiaAI Fellowship Programme offering funding up to one lakh rupees for students.
